review_comments.body: if two whole tool calls both arrive with index 0 (some OpenAI compatible APIs do that), they still collapse into one slot here. the new tests only cover a missing index. worth treating a new call id under an occupied index as a separate call?

Good catch: a call that arrives with a new `id` under an index that already holds a different id now opens its own entry (indices map to entries instead of being list positions), so two whole calls both sent with `index: 0` stay separate. Continuation chunks without an `id` still append to the call at their index. Added `test_whole_tool_calls_that_all_use_index_zero_stay_separate` (3875734).

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
